final: WITH by_media AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Track) SELECT by_media.MediaTypeId, by_media.avg_price, by_media.avg_price / overall.avg_price FROM by_media CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.avg_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY by_media.avg_price / overall.avg_price DESC LIMIT 10
